plugins.name: zcode-context
plugins.description: Context-usage insight dashboard for ZCode: overview KPIs, 7-day token+cost chart, 8-week activity heatmap, click-to-filter tool/command/project rankings, per-session context composition bar, collapsible context browser, trend chart with pinned request detail, event log & file activity filters, cost composition, agent formation view. Purely local read-only SQLite; no other plugins or system Node.js required. Injected via app.asar; requires a restart.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 上下文洞察仪表盘：洞察总览（会话/Token/费用估算/缓存命中率/工具调用/活跃时长 KPI）、近 7 天 Token+费用图、近 8 周活跃热力图、可点击筛选的工具/命令/项目排行、单会话上下文构成条、可折叠上下文浏览器、趋势图（可固定单步详情）、事件日志与文件活动筛选、费用构成、Agent 编队视图。纯本地只读 SQLite 查询，不依赖其他插件，无需系统 Node.js。通过 app.asar 注入，安装/更新后需重启 ZCode。
